schemaMarkup.reviewBody: I moved to Charlotte fairly recently and have been to Riccobene Ballantyne for my past 2 cleanings. The staff is so kind and welcoming. Kelly was my hygienist on my most recent visit and she made the whole experience very comfortable and left my teeth feeling great. Dr. Ge is very clear about what treatment is needed and why. I am very happy about my choice of dentist in Charlotte.

I highly recommend Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry. We have been going to this office since relocating to the area. We were very pleased to find a dentist's office that was as good as what we were used to. I recently visited for my regular cleaning which included x-rays. Darby was my hygienist. Darby gave me what felt like the most thorough cleaning that I can remember, but she was so precise and gentle that I could have taken a nap but for the need to be awake to spit every once and a while. She even encouraged me to re-start the wearing of my retainer. Great job Darby, my teeth are as bright as ever.

I’ve been coming here for years now (about 5) and have had great experience each time. Very pleasant front desk, dental assistants, and dentist (and anyone else I missed) have all been wonderful. They also don’t seem to recommend work that doesn’t need to be done, but only what is needed. I drive here from Gastonia just to keep coming here!

This was my first visit… from the receptionist who was lovely to the X-ray technician another enjoyable person to the doctor, who listened to me to the hygienist, again was lovely. I felt very comfortable and welcomed to this grand group.

I’ve been going to Dr. Jakubek’s office for almost a decade now.  His team is friendly and always ready for each appointment.  And he does amazing work!  I had him replace some crowns I got when I was younger and they looked much better than what I had.  I highly recommend him for your dental needs.

Excellent in every way. Outstanding doctors and personnel. Dr. Smilies has been so good with all my dental needs, and Aimee makes a huge difference with her patience and caring. Thank you so much for taking such good care of me! Elena

The service and Dental treatment at Riccobene & Associates is second to none. The staff is very friendly and Linda my dental hygienist did an AMAZING job with my cleaning. I highly recommend this Dentistry

Dr. Supneet Wadhwa began his dental career at Christian Dental College in India, where he earned 23 gold medals and honors. After completing a three-year residency in Prosthodontics and later earning his DDS from the Colorado School of Dental Medicine, Dr. Wadhwa has built a reputation for excellence in crowns, dentures, implants, and pediatric dentistry, bringing over two decades of experience to his patients.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services do you provide in Charlotte?

At Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry in Charlotte, NC, we offer comprehensive services including preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, restorative treatments, implants, orthodontics, and emergency care—all in one convenient, welcoming office.

Can I get dental implants in Charlotte?

Yes. Our Charlotte office provides dental implant services as a long-lasting solution for missing teeth. Implants look and function like natural teeth, restoring chewing ability, appearance, and confidence.

Do you provide pediatric dentistry in Charlotte?

Absolutely. We provide gentle pediatric dental care in Charlotte, helping children feel comfortable while protecting developing teeth with cleanings, sealants, fluoride, and education for lifelong oral health habits.

Are your Charlotte dental services safe for seniors?

Yes. Our Charlotte dental care is tailored for patients of every age, including seniors. We use advanced technology and compassionate approaches to ensure safe, effective treatment for older adults.

Do you provide orthodontic treatments in Charlotte?

Yes. Our Charlotte office offers orthodontic options including Invisalign® and other treatments designed to straighten teeth comfortably, improve function, and enhance your smile’s appearance.
